Title: Very Low Emissions (1.9 W/m2)
Description: Limits warming to 1.5 degrees C. Requires net zero CO2 around 2050 followed by net negative emissions.

Title: Low Emissions (2.6 W/m2)
Description: Limits warming to well below 2 degrees C. Strong mitigation with CO2 emissions reaching net zero after 2050.

Title: Intermediate Emissions (4.5 W/m2)
Description: Intermediate emissions following broadly historical social and economic trends with moderate mitigation.

Title: High Emissions (7.0 W/m2)
Description: High emissions assuming regional rivalry and no additional climate policies.

Title: Low to Intermediate Emissions (3.4 W/m2)
Description: Low to intermediate emissions assuming high inequality between and within countries with moderate mitigation efforts.

Title: High Emissions (6.0 W/m2)
Description: High emissions assuming high inequality between and within countries and limited mitigation.

Title: Low to Intermediate Emissions - Overshoot (3.4 W/m2)
Description: Overshoot pathway following high emissions before rapid decline to 3.4 W/m2 by 2100. Paired with SSP4-3.4 but assumes fossil-fuel intensive development with late-century mitigation.

Title: Very High Emissions (8.5 W/m2)
Description: Very high emissions assuming fossil-fuel intensive development and no mitigation. Upper bound of the scenario range.

Title: Very Low Emissions (RCP2.6)
Description: Very stringent mitigation pathway requiring net negative greenhouse gas emissions after 2070.

Title: Intermediate Emissions (RCP4.5)
Description: Intermediate stabilisation pathway with moderate mitigation efforts.

Title: High Emissions (RCP6.0)
Description: Stabilisation pathway in which emissions peak around 2080 then decline.

Title: Very High Emissions (RCP8.5)
Description: High-end baseline with continuously rising emissions throughout the 21st century.

Title: High Emissions
Description: Emissions grow as high as plausibly possible consistent with a rollback of current climate policies. Expected warming of around 3.5 degrees C by 2100 continuing to rise thereafter.

Title: High-to-Low Emissions
Description: Emissions initially follow the High scenario then are cut sharply in the second half of the century reaching net zero by 2100. Explores a late but rapid decarbonisation trajectory.

Title: Medium Emissions
Description: Emissions consistent with current policies frozen as of 2025 leading to moderate warming above 3 degrees C by 2100. Serves as the primary baseline scenario for CMIP7.

Title: Medium-to-Low Emissions
Description: Emissions are slowly reduced eventually reaching net zero GHG emissions before 2100. Consistent with a gradual strengthening of current climate policies.

Title: Low Emissions
Description: Emissions consistent with likely keeping warming below 2 degrees C without returning to 1.5 degrees C before the end of the century.

Title: Low-to-Negative Emissions
Description: Emissions fall slightly slower than the Very Low scenario with temperatures initially rising above 1.5 degrees C before rapidly declining to negative to bring warming back down.

Title: Very Low Emissions
Description: Emissions cut to keep warming as low as plausibly achievable. Limits warming to approximately 1.5 degrees C by end of century with limited overshoot. Reaches net zero CO2 around 2055 then relies on net negative emissions.
